text:
harper: Drafting a tiny Optimize Toolkit FAQ on micro-batching + kv-prefetch tradeoffs when using quantized kernels. Needs: one short decision para, two tiny SDK snippets (Go + Python), and a one-line migration note. Looking for a quick review.

devin: Keep snippets under 10 lines and use <model-name> placeholders. I'll check the Go example and run a quick smoke.

miko: I can do the Python one and confirm the quant-doc anchor. I think it's #quantization-guidance now.

harper: Draft decision paragraph (very short):
"Micro-batching increases throughput at higher concurrency but can add 95th percentile latency for single-user short sequences. With quantized weights, kv-prefetch may increase peak RAM; prefer explicit kv_prefetch settings and benchmark representative workloads."

harper: Go snippet (devin to validate):
```go
// pseudocode - redwood-go
client := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
req := redwood.GenerationRequest{Model: "<model-name>", MaxTokens: 48, Batching: redwood.Micro{MaxBatchTokens: 256}, KVPrefetch: false}
resp, _ := client.Generate(req)
fmt.Println(resp.Text)
```

devin: I'll run this against q4 build tonight. Quick note: we should prefer explicit KVPrefetch field in Go snippets (don't rely on default).

miko: Python snippet (small):
```py
# pseudocode - redwood python
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))
resp = c.generate({"model":"<model-name>","max_tokens":64,"batching":{"type":"micro","max_batch_tokens":512},"kv_prefetch":False})
print(resp.text)
```

miko: I'll lint and run a smoke. Also will update the cross-ref to /optimize/quant-profiles.md#quantization-guidance.

harper: Migration blurb (one-line):
"Older examples defaulted to kv-prefetch on; with quant kernels that increases RAM—explicitly set kv_prefetch and benchmark."

docs-bot: Reminder: include samplegen metadata (opt/microbatch-quant) and run code-block linting per CONTRIBUTING.md.

devin: Perf note from a local quick run: micro-batching (256 tokens) improved throughput at high QPS but increased 95th latency for single short sessions. Add a one-sentence recommendation: single-request streaming for low-concurrency short sessions; micro-batching when throughput matters.

miko: Confirmed anchor is #quantization-guidance. I'll update links in the PR.

harper: Opening a WIP PR now and tagging @devin @miko. Please review by EOD Thursday if possible. :rocket:
